alternative_alert_call.name: Momentum ATR - alert calls - simulation
alternative_alert_call.warning: Do not send this and the order-fill alert to the same receiver. Entry and momentum messages represent decisions; stop alert() messages are observed at bar close.

authentication.signature_format: sha256=<lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw request body>
authentication.secret_location: TRADINGVIEW_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the signing gateway and receiver only
authentication.important: TradingView alerts cannot calculate this HMAC or add the signature header. Point TradingView at a controlled signing gateway, which must forward the unchanged body with the signature header. Never place the HMAC secret in Pine code or this JSON.
